correctness.rationale: For 6|n, n±1 odd and indivisible by3, so offsets 0,±2,±3,±5 around n yield safe sums. Explicit cyclic auxiliary ordering of 0..m-1 with jumps 2,3 (exceptional m=6,9 allow5) lifts by reflection to an alternating ordering missing only m=n/2. The adjacent pair (m+3,m-3) is present, and inserting m replaces safe sum n by n±3, preserving endpoints and wraparound. n=6 checked separately. Independently reconstructed all 200 positive multiples through n=1200 with exact integer gcd and permutation checks; unrestricted proof is the explicit parameter formula.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks are bounded; full quantifiers depend on inspected analytic or finite-exhaustive reduction arguments.

evidence: The source Sun theorem proves odd parameters by a distinct construction and leaves even cases conjectural; the result n=6k is disjoint from the proven odd class. General Hamiltonicity of gcd(vertex labels) graph has a different edge rule.
